mapper.select:
select l.log_id, l.activity_id, l.member_id, l.change_type, l.change_amount, l.balance_after, l.biz_no, l.rule_id, l.remark, l.create_by, l.create_time, m.phone, m.real_name, a.title as activity_title, r.rule_name from biz_lottery_chance_log l left join biz_member m on m.member_id = l.member_id left join biz_lottery_activity a on a.activity_id = l.activity_id left join biz_lottery_chance_rule r on r.rule_id = l.rule_id
and l.activity_id = #{activityId} and l.member_id = #{memberId} and l.change_type = #{changeType} and m.phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%') and l.create_time >= #{params.beginTime} and l.create_time < date_add(#{params.endTime}, interval 1 day)
order by l.log_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_lottery_chance_log ( activity_id, member_id, change_type, change_amount, balance_after, biz_no, rule_id, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{activityId}, #{memberId}, #{changeType}, #{changeAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{bizNo}, #{ruleId}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
